name: living-themes
description: Animated backdrops behind the chat in the desktop app that react to what Claude is doing (thinking, running tools, subagents, a failure, a merge) and follow your local time of day and season; /live-theme picks one.

utcOffset.title: UTC offset
utcOffset.description: Your clock's offset from UTC, such as +5:30 or -8. Empty: read it from the system clock.

hemisphere.title: Hemisphere
hemisphere.description: Which half of the world you live in, for the seasons.

reactToAgent.title: React to Claude
reactToAgent.description: Let the scene change with what Claude is doing. Off: only the time of day and the season change it (the same as /live-theme calm on, for every session).
